image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cooked Dungeness crab served on a white plate. The crab's carapace is reddish-orange with some darker mottling. Several legs and claws are visible, appearing disjointed or broken, typical of a prepared meal. A metal crab cracker tool rests in the foreground. The background includes blurred elements of the dish, possibly onions or garnish.
